note: 2026-11-27. Three glosses found while curating the feed's Wortbau compounds (src/data/wortbau.ts). der Hafen read «harbour/harbour», the only doubled gloss in the corpus. das Geschoss (A2) taught only «projectile», with the same sentence about a teacher being shot twice, where an A2 learner meets the word as a floor of a building (Erdgeschoss, Obergeschoss and Kellergeschoss are all cards). die Taschenlampe carried a definition in its gloss.

expect.def: Something fired from a weapon, such as a bullet.

rows.def: One level of a building; also, something fired from a weapon.

expect.de: Der Lehrer wurde von einem Geschoss getroffen.
expect.en: The teacher was hit by a projectile.

rows.en: We live on the third floor.

expect.de: Die Lehrerin wurde von einem Geschoss getroffen.
expect.en: The teacher was hit by a projectile.

rows.de: Das Büro liegt im ersten Geschoss.
rows.en: The office is on the first floor.

expect.en: A torch, a flashlight: a portable electric light source
